name: Explainability, Attribution Semantics, SHAP Mathematics & Prediction-to-Explanation Binding Execution Map

execution_graph.feature_enrichment: FeatureStoreService online feature store aggregation (velocity, historical counts, device history)
execution_graph.prediction_output_space: Fraud probability p in [0, 1], calibrated score in [0, 1000]
execution_graph.background_population: 30 synthetic stratified baseline reference points spanning feature range [c_min, c_max]
execution_graph.attribution_transformation: raw_shap[0] -> float64 array -> abs/signed contribution -> direction INCREASES_RISK / DECREASES_RISK
execution_graph.feature_name_association: SHAP_FEATURE_NAMES index 0..9 mapped directly to FEATURE_NAMES in data_generator
execution_graph.reason_code_generation: 9-signal policy breakdown matching threshold criteria (HIGH-AMT, VEL-001, GEO-RISK, etc.)

caching.realtime_cache: Tenant-isolated Redis / LRU cache keyed by cfi:shap:{tenant_id}:{transaction_id} with 300s TTL

execution_graph.frontend: Predictor.tsx & AlertsPage.tsx rendering with directional styling, continuous absolute magnitude bars, and truthful method labels

graph_explanation_path.as_of_binding: Historical alert.created_at timestamp passed to find_neighbors and get_subgraph
graph_explanation_path.attribution: EdgeContribution list normalized to 100% relative graph contribution
